annotations.title: Match a brief to marketing agencies

description: Match a buyer's own question to Dutch marketing agencies. Infers the specialisms from the brief; search_agencies takes specialisms the buyer already knows. Input: the brief in the buyer's words (NL or EN, 20-2000 chars), optionally with the same hard filters as search_agencies (city, near_city + within_km, target_industry, client_orientation, company_size_band, budget_band, agency_size). The brief is redacted for personal data first and never stored; a call takes a few seconds. Ranking fuses the match score, how close the agency's profile is to the brief, and public case evidence in the sectors the brief names. Returns up to 20 ranked agencies (slug, name, 1-line Dutch rationale citing the agency's evidence, team_size, client_sectors, top_case, via: specialism | brief | both) and `interpreted`: the specialisms and working style read from the brief, plus a follow-up question when the brief is unclear. `interpreted` shows the buyer how the brief was read; search_agencies accepts explicit specialisms. Ranking ignores what an agency pays (never pay-to-rank).

agency_size.description: Size of the AGENCY itself (KvK registered employees): 1-9, 10-49, 50-249, 250+ or geen-voorkeur. Agencies without a known KvK count stay in (filters.agency_size.unknown).

brief.description: The buyer's own words (NL or EN, 20-2000 chars). The question itself, not a summary.

budget_band.description: Buyer's budget in EUR. Only excludes agencies whose known rates conflict; most agencies have no known rate.

city.description: Exact office city of the agency. For 'near a city' use near_city + within_km instead.

client_orientation.description: b2b or b2c focus of the agency.

company_size_band.description: Size of the buyer's company (employees); matches agencies that target that segment.

near_city.description: Center of a radius search: any Dutch city name. Requires within_km.

near_lat.description: Center latitude of a radius search (alternative to near_city). Requires near_lon + within_km.

near_lon.description: Center longitude of a radius search (alternative to near_city). Requires near_lat + within_km.

target_industry.description: Client vertical the agency serves (e.g. the buyer's own industry). Not the agency's own sector.

within_km.description: Radius in kilometres around near_city or near_lat/near_lon (max 250). Ignored without an origin; near_* is ignored without within_km.
